reasonCodes.missing_cash_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} is missing its recorded cash payment.
reasonCodes.missing_card_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} is missing its recorded card payment.
reasonCodes.missing_local_payment_row: Order {{orderNumber}} is marked paid but its local payment record is missing.
reasonCodes.partial_cash_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} still has unpaid cash remaining.
reasonCodes.partial_card_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} still has unpaid card remaining.
reasonCodes.split_payment_incomplete: Order {{orderNumber}} still has an incomplete split payment.
reasonCodes.unsupported_payment_method: Order {{orderNumber}} uses a payment method that must be collected manually.
reasonCodes.no_persisted_payment: Order {{orderNumber}} was completed without a saved cash or card payment.
reasonCodes.duplicate_payment: The same transaction is recorded more than once on {{orderNumber}}: {{settledAmount}} against an order of {{totalAmount}}.
reasonCodes.overpaid_order: Payments on {{orderNumber}} exceed the order by {{overpaidAmount}}: {{netSettledAmount}} recorded against an order of {{ceilingAmount}}.
reasonCodes.platform_settlement_missing: The platform settles {{orderNumber}}, but no platform settlement of {{totalAmount}} is recorded.
reasonCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch: The money on {{orderNumber}} is recorded on the wrong side: the platform and the till cannot both hold it.
reasonCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch__platform_h: The platform settles {{orderNumber}}, but {{drawerAmount}} is recorded as cash or card in the till.
reasonCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch__store_coll: {{orderNumber}} is a store order, but {{platformSettledAmount}} is booked as platform-settled money.
{{orderNumber}} was delivered by our own driver, but {{platformSettledAmount}} is booked as platform-settled money.

fixCodes.missing_cash_payment: Record or confirm the missing cash payment.
fixCodes.missing_card_payment: Record or confirm the missing card payment.
fixCodes.missing_local_payment_row: Refresh payment mirrors or recreate the missing payment record.
fixCodes.partial_cash_payment: Record the remaining cash payment to continue.
fixCodes.partial_card_payment: Record the remaining card payment to continue.
fixCodes.split_payment_incomplete: Complete all split-payment portions before continuing.
fixCodes.unsupported_payment_method: Review the order and collect the payment manually.
fixCodes.no_persisted_payment: Record the payment that was actually taken for this order.
fixCodes.duplicate_payment: Void the duplicate payment row, keeping one payment per real transaction.
fixCodes.overpaid_order: Refund or void the excess payment so the ledger matches the order total.
fixCodes.platform_settlement_missing: Re-run the platform settlement for this order so the money is recorded as platform revenue.
fixCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch: Void the row on the wrong side so the money is recorded where it really is.
fixCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch__platform_h: Void the cash or card row: prepaid and platform-rider money never enters the drawer.
fixCodes.platform_settlement_mismatch__store_coll: Void the platform settlement row and record the cash or card the store actually took.
Void the platform settlement row and record the cash or card the driver actually brought back.

blockerReasons.parent_payment_not_synced: Waiting for the parent payment to sync first.
blockerReasons.parent_payment_missing_canonical_remote_: Waiting for the parent payment to receive its remote payment id.
blockerReasons.ambiguous_canonical_remote_payment: Multiple repaired payments match this adjustment. Manual review is required.

closeoutBlocked.single: Cannot close the day during {{stage}} because {{orderReference}} is still blocked: {{reason}}.
closeoutBlocked.multiple: Cannot close the day during {{stage}} because {{count}} sync items are still blocked.
